sections.body: Gordon up the middle against BUF's interior is the first matchup, with Miami's run EPA at -0.11 [mc1] and 40.1% of designed runs going up the middle [mc4]. With Brewer Out after 100.0% of snaps per game [mc5], the backup center is the interior question, so keep linebackers square to the A-gaps. The second matchup is Miami's extra rushers against BUF's protection: Miami sends them on 22.1% of dropbacks [mc7], and BUF has allowed a pressure proxy of 14.9% [mc9], so the backup tackle needs chip help on the edge. Get Washington on quick throws, since he draws 22.0% of targets [mc13]. The third matchup is BUF's vertical passing: BUF produces explosive pass plays on 12.9% of attempts [mc14], and Miami allows them on 8.9% [mc15], so attack the one-on-one matchup outside when Miami sends extra rushers. For the fourth, with Bell Doubtful after taking 10.8% of targets [mc20], Douglas at 15.1% [mc21] and Dulcich at 14.7% [mc22] will absorb more work, so BUF should rush a standard front on early downs and spy the quarterback's first read.
